text: A plumbing build repairs its review's findings before asking a person (#281, #297). When the second agent's review asks for changes, the factory hands its findings to the same builder, in the same workspace and under the same ratified plan and file scope, for at most two repair rounds, each followed by fresh checks and a fresh review. A build is published ready only when its final review approves. The builder may add regression test files in the packages its plan touches, which CI's scope check admits, while the ratified acceptance tests stay unchanged. Work only the merger can do, such as recording a decision or running checks that need Docker or the network, never makes a review ask for changes. Every round counts against the build's single time allowance, and its usage adds to the build's. #297 merged over its review's three edge cases, which #298 fixes, so that the builds waiting on the repair loop could use it.
